origin: LTspice schematics by the maintainer, LTspice 26.1.1's -netlist exports of them, and variants made for M16, each changing one form
author: xdylanm
notes: Exported by LTspice 26.1.1 with -netlist; the first comment line holds the absolute schematic path in the export and is replaced by the file name. Provenance confirmed by the maintainer, 2026-11-09.

.gitignore.note: Keeps LTspice run output out, as in controlled_sources (decision 0009).

lt_tline_T_zo.cir.note: T with the reference's spelling Zo= (variant of the export, which writes Z0=).

test_ltspice_tline_O.asc.note: O: a lossy line with an LTRA model (schematic by the maintainer).

test_ltspice_tline_O_reject.asc.note: O with the model in SpiceModel and LTRA left in Value (schematic by the maintainer); its export is a reject.

test_ltspice_tline_O_reject.net.note: LTspice 26.1.1's export of test_ltspice_tline_O_reject.asc: `O1 … myline LTRA`, which LTspice stops on ("Unknown parameter") and the library refuses: O takes nothing after its model (decision 0019).

test_ltspice_tline_T.asc.note: T: a lossless line, the tline symbol's defaults (schematic by the maintainer).

test_ltspice_tline_U.asc.note: U: a URC line with L= and N= (schematic by the maintainer).
